notes.title: Smile Simulation v1.0.6!
notes.content:
Hey everyone
First of all, thanks so much for playing Smile Simulation!
I'm glad to see that the game is scary and interesting, thank you!

I also wanted to share the news that the game is available in English, German, Spanish, Italian and Korean languages, making it more accessible for a lot more people.

Thanks everyone again, I really appreciate the support,

Vidas
